mapper.select: SELECT l.replacement_order_id FROM xsy_order_exchange_link l JOIN xsy_sales_order o ON o.id = l.replacement_order_id WHERE l.return_id = #{returnId} AND o.deleted = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xsy_order_exchange_link(return_id, original_order_id, replacement_order_id, created_by) VALUES (#{returnId}, #{originalOrderId}, #{replacementOrderId}, #{operator})
